program.subject: Back & knees care
program.blurb: Wrists, shoulders and upper back for every fuck where you hold yourself up on your hands over her.
program.about: Missionary, doggy and the wheelbarrow all put weight through your hands while you fuck her. One day strengthens the wrists and forearms through their range; the other builds shoulder health and upper-back strength with a short mobility flow. Level II adds reps, Level III holds longer.
